rationale: The material prompt requirement is framework-agnostic bottleneck analysis beyond Core Web Vitals and Vercel-specific scope. At # Next on Vercel Performance, the source is scoped to Diagnose and fix Core Web Vitals and page performance of a Next.js app on Vercel - measurement-first. Use when an LCP/INP/CLS score is bad, a page "feels slow", Lighthouse/PageSpeed/Speed Insights is red, the JS bundle is too big, images or fonts are janky, or you want Vercel-specific caching/edge w; it provides a meaningful neighbouring route but does not establish framework-agnostic bottleneck analysis beyond Core Web Vitals and Vercel-specific scope as required by the prompt.
